name: Maison
description: Maison is a lightweight self-hosted dashboard for managing Docker apps on a single host. It is a dashboard-only reimagining of CasaOS: same look, same feel, same app store — but stripped down to a home screen for your apps and a store to install more. Ships as one container: a Go binary with Svelte UI, no database required.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Host path for app data. Apps installed by Maison bind their volumes here.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Docker socket for managing containers on the host

paths.name: Host Proc
paths.description: Host /proc mount for system resource monitoring

variables.name: DATA_ROOT
variables.description: Data folder path inside the container

variables.name: DATA_HOST_PATH
variables.description: Host path of the data folder. Must match the Data Path mount source.
